text: What is the primary purpose of a Debt-to-Income (DTI) ratio in mortgage underwriting?
options: To assess the borrower's ability to manage monthly payments
master_rationale: DTI is a key metric used to evaluate if a borrower can afford the new mortgage payment alongside existing debts.

text: Is a credit score of 580 generally sufficient for a standard conventional mortgage?
master_rationale: Conventional loans typically require a minimum score of 620, though FHA loans may allow 580.

text: What is the maximum standard LTV ratio for a primary residence conventional loan without PMI?
master_rationale: LTV ratios above 80% typically require Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI).

text: Which document is most critical for verifying self-employed income?
options: Two years of personal and business tax returns
master_rationale: Self-employed income requires a comprehensive review of tax returns to determine stable, ongoing income.
